title: 93 old bombs, explosives found in Sulu junk shop

blocks.text: PAGADIAN CITY, Zamboanga del Sur – Philippine Coast Guard (PCG) personnel recovered 93 assorted pieces of unexploded ordnance, including a massive 500-pound World War II-era aerial bomb, at a junk shop in Barangay Alat, Jolo, Sulu on Monday. The retrieval operation was launched after authorities received reports regarding the discovery of heavily corroded explosive materials
